def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    monthly_payment = 500
    annual_interest_rate = 0.06
    monthly_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate / 12
    number_of_periods = 10 * 12

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    future_value = (
        monthly_payment
        * (((1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** number_of_periods - 1) / monthly_interest_rate)
        * (1 + monthly_interest_rate)
    )

    # return answer
    return round(future_value)
